text:
Type: double bell pendant lamp
Use: light over a long dining table or a kitchen island; dining room, kitchen
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: white lacquered metal shades, aluminium crossbar, steel suspension wires, transparent cords, grey ceiling cup
Colors: white, silver grey
Shape: two rounded bell shades joined by a long horizontal bar, hung on thin wires in a triangle from a single ceiling cup, wide and airy, light visual weight
Feel: clean, balanced, light, functional
Goes with: long white or light wood dining tables, grey accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern dining rooms

product.name: SVIRVEL
product.description: This lamp gives a pleasant light for dining and spreads a good directed light across your dining or bar table.
